How do climate hazards, emissions choices, and adaptation capacity affect ecological and social resilience?
:::

## Questions we examine

- Who faces the greatest climate risks, and why?
- Which adaptation and mitigation responses have credible evidence of effectiveness?
- How are climate costs and benefits distributed across places and generations?
